title: Account consolidation case, plan and result v1
description: The D-070 duplicate-account consolidation record: which identity survives, which is absorbed, exactly which claims move, and what the result was. docs/security/RANKED_IDENTITY_ELIGIBILITY.md is the normative owner, packages/schemas/planning-schema.sql#consolidation_cases and #consolidation_contributions are the persistence owners, and the account-consolidation machine owns the lifecycle. The plan is a list of claim-level contributions and never a pair of totals: D-070 forbids adding two stored account totals, so the surviving standing is recomputed from the contributions below rather than incremented by a figure. Imported records stay excluded under D-007 and D-087, and an overlapping duplicate domain counts once under D-269.

contributions.description: The plan. Every claim the case considered appears exactly once, including the ones it excluded, so the case explains what it dropped and why rather than being silent about a difference.

state.description: applied is not terminal. A successful appeal moves the case to reversed, which appends inverse contributions rather than deleting anything, so an accepted claim stays immutable under D-263.

initiated_by.description: A participant-initiated and an investigation-initiated consolidation differ in what the participant is told, never in what the arithmetic does.

identity_investigation_id.description: Required exactly when initiated_by is investigation.

claim_id.description: Cleared when an erasure deletes the claim. The arithmetic that produced a standing stays auditable; the link to the claim does not survive.

period_id.description: The original period the claim was attributed to, not the period the consolidation runs in. D-070 requires original period attribution to be preserved, which means a contribution absorbed today can still land in a period that closed last year, subject to that period's own freeze boundary.

duplicate_domain_commitment.description: The observer-equivalence key from packages/schemas/observer-equivalence-v1.json, lowercase hex over 32 bytes. Two contributions with one commitment are one execution seen twice, so the second is excluded rather than counted.

token_burn_total.description: The raw accepted quantity of the originating claim, carried unchanged. A consolidation never renormalises, reweights or rounds a figure; ADR-020 applies the confidence weight at projection.

result.description: What the case actually did, recorded as counts rather than as a summed total. There is deliberately no combined_token_burn_total field: a single figure here would be the stored-total summation D-070 forbids, and every consumer that needs a standing recomputes it from score_contributions.

erasure_domain_link_established.description: True when the case wrote the erasure_domain_links edge. It has to be written, because an erasure walks the closure and destroying only the survivor's key would leave the absorbed history attributable.

rebuilt_generation_count.description: How many ranking generations were rebuilt as successors. A consolidation never edits a sealed generation; it supersedes it, under D-211 and D-263.
